data.name: Touch of Ecstasy
data.description: An enchanting courtesan has perfectly mastered the sensual arts. As a standard action, the enchanting courtesan can touch a living target to saturate its being with pure bliss. An unwilling target can be affected with a melee touch attack. The target is filled with ecstatic pleasure for 1d4 rounds. The pleasure suppresses all pain effects during this time. The target must attempt a Fortitude save (DC %1). If it succeeds at this saving throw, the target is staggered for the duration. If it fails, it is stunned instead. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. Any effect or immunity that prevents precision damage negates this ability.|20+WIS
